what: Outside-ROOT fallback contradicts scan_file path join
scenario_or_breakage: Plan says paths outside $ROOT use the absolute path as both rel and path, but scan_file always sets path="$ROOT/$rel". New harness cases call bash "$LINT" "$TMPROOT/scripts/..." without --root while $TMPROOT is outside $REPO_ROOT, so path becomes $REPO_ROOT/$TMPROOT/... (nonexistent), scan_file returns 0 at the -f guard, and violation tests false-pass
suggested_fix: In scan_file (or the positional branch), if the resolved file is absolute or not under $ROOT, set path to that absolute path; otherwise set rel relative to $ROOT and path="$ROOT/$rel". Align harness invocations with the contract (e.g. cd "$TMPROOT" && bash "$LINT" --root . scripts/good.sh, or pass --root "$TMPROOT" with paths under that root)
